extracted.intended_audience: cardiovascular researchers (prospective or current applicants to British Heart Foundation funding)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview guidance and signposting for researchers seeking British Heart Foundation (BHF) funding, covering what is funded, how to apply, managing awards, reviewer opportunities, and related programmes and policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: What we fund
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide personal support for clinical and non-clinical cardiovascular researchers. We also provide grants for research projects and other awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discover our research grant options (link to detailed list of grant types and eligibility).

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply for funding and grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about BHF research grants and how to apply for funding to support research into causes, prevention, diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signposting to application pages and procedures for different grant schemes.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to apply for funding (applicant support)
rubrics_metrics.description: We're here to support you throughout the grant application process. If you’re a new applicant, please ask a senior colleague for advice first.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read tips on preparing a grant application; seek mentorship from senior colleagues when new to applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing your grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out how to successfully manage your BHF grant for its duration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read guidance on grant management, reporting, and compliance during the award period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Get more advice with your application
rubrics_metrics.description: Need help with your grant application? Contact us and we'll be happy to help.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opportunity to speak to BHF staff for application queries and support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Becoming an independent peer reviewer or funding committee member
rubrics_metrics.description: Register interest to become an independent expert peer reviewer, or a member of a BHF funding committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Find out how to register your interest and the expectations for reviewers/committee members.

rubrics_metrics.name: CardioStars (research translation & commercialisation programme)
rubrics_metrics.description: CardioStars is a BHF-funded research translation and commercialisation programme that equips researchers with entrepreneurial and business skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learn about the programme objectives and application process for CardioStars.

rubrics_metrics.name: Researcher noticeboard
rubrics_metrics.description: The researcher noticeboard shares the latest news on BHF-funded research, and upcoming events and opportunities for the researcher community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visit the noticeboard to find calls, events, and community announcements relevant to applicants and awardees.

rubrics_metrics.name: How we award (committee meeting frequency)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each of our committees meets 4 times a year, excluding the Clinical Studies Committee and the Translational Awards Committee, who meet twice a year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational detail on assessment cadence which may affect submission deadlines and decision timelines; further detail available on the 'how we award' page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet our researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: Profiles of award holders ranging from PhD students to senior research fellows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read researcher bios to see examples of previously funded investigators and projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Our previous grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on research grants the BHF has previously funded for a variety of long and short term research projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discover past awards to understand the types of projects funded and potential fit for new proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Our commitment to DORA
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on how the BHF is implementing the DORA principles to promote a fair and open research ecosystem.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on responsible research assessment practices and how DORA affects evaluation of applicants and outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Our research strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: The BHF research strategy sets out ambitions to advance scientific progress to save and improve lives from cardiovascular diseases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read the strategy to align proposals with BHF priorities and strategic objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global Cardiovascular Research Funders Forum (GCRFF)
rubrics_metrics.description: The GCRFF is a global partnership of major cardiovascular research funders; information on the group's work and its impact on research policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Context on international coordination and policy influences that may inform funding priorities.
